_what: Settings of the check tool (README.md). prepare.py reads them to build the tables of records; server.py reads them to serve the page.
_year: The year whose posttrained file is checked. runs must name its run folder. The tool was built and tested on 2015.
_runs: For each year: the pipeline's run folder (REBUILD_OUT; it holds settings.json, data/ and tilt/<tilt_run>/file_<year>.parquet) and the tilt run's name. 2015: the integration run of 2 November, on the current code (its solve took 71 Newton steps, so the budget of 150 set on 3 November changes nothing). 2019: the simplification's rerun of 3 November, byte for byte the same file as the integration run of 2 November.
_puf_source: The source for PUF items. 'puf_and_tax_data_nonfilers' (John, 3 November): every PUF return, dependent filers included, on its own weights and in its own dollars, plus the non-filer units of the pipeline's tax data for the year (build_table.tax_data, as the table stage wrote it to data/tax_data_<year>.parquet). Defined only for the PUF's year, 2015. 'tax_data': the pipeline's tax data for the year exactly as build_table.tax_data defines it (PUF returns other than dependent filers, weights scaled by SOI Table 1.6, dollars grown per return, plus the non-filers); the PUF items it does not carry are taken from the same PUF returns, grown the same way (build_table.grown). Changing this needs prepare.py run again.
_cache: Where prepare.py writes the tables of records, one folder per year and source definition. The folder is readable by the owner and the pi_nrs36 group only: it holds licensed PUF microdata.
_thin_cell_records: A cell resting on fewer sample records than this, in either file, is marked thin on the page. Records are counted as each file's sample units (README, 'What a record is').
_port_range: server.py picks a free port at random in this range unless --port is given.
